claim: Each workload that runs on AWS Fargate is given full access to 20 GiB of ephemeral storage to use as temporary storage while it runs, and data in this volume is erased once the workload stops; this ephemeral storage volume can be expanded up to 200GiB on Amazon ECS and 175 GiB on Amazon EKS.

qualifiers.condition: temporary; erased when the workload stops

evidence.quote: Each workload that runs on AWS Fargate is given full access to 20 GiB of ephemeral storage to use as temporary storage while the workload is running. Once the workload has stopped, any data stored in this 20 GiB volume is erased. This ephemeral storage volume can be expanded up to 200GiB on Amazon ECS and 175 GiB on Amazon EKS.
